covers: sha256 over the canonical form of every case's {id, freeze_status, expect.verdict, expect.detected_by(sorted)}, sorted by id. Computed by freezeDigest() in substitution.js.
proves: The frozen expectations have not drifted since the commit that introduced this file. Any later run prints MATCH or DRIFT against a dated ref.
cannot_prove: WHEN any individual expectation was authored. The first commit containing the harness (a2ede06d) already carries the revised freeze, so git cannot date round 1 and neither can this ledger. freeze_status values ORIGINAL_ROUND_1 and ORIGINAL_ROUND_2 remain AUTHOR ASSERTIONS. Residual correctly raised by GROK in non-author review, 2026-09-16; it is not retroactively fixable, only bounded going forward.
how_to_verify: status MATCH means the live freeze equals this ledger; DRIFT means a frozen expectation changed after this commit.
